thread-cart/README.md

Thread Cart

E-commerce clothing app for Men, Women and Kids, built during MERN training.

  • Responsive React.js interface made from reusable components.
  • RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express.js for routing and business logic.
  • MongoDB with Mongoose: user authentication, cart management and product CRUD.
  • Version-controlled with Git and GitHub.
  • Tested database operations: insert, read, update and delete on products, users and orders.
